summary: Industrial-strength restoration. A fast-absorbing, non-greasy compound that heals micro-cracks and environmental weathering on overworked hands.
description: Dermal reinforcement for the extremities. This heavy-duty formula creates a glove-like, protective polymer shield over the hands, locking in deep glycerin hydration that survives multiple hand-washings.
technical_overview: Offered at $20.0 for 75ml, this KoColor HAND_CREAM is expertly formulated with Glycerin (20%), Shea Butter, and Dimethicone. It delivers a high-fidelity Soft Silk color profile (`#FFFAFA`) and leverages high-density occlusive shielding.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Massage a pea-sized amount into hands, focusing on knuckles and cuticles.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Apply generously before washing dishes or cleaning; the high dimethicone content will act as a physical water-repellent barrier.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: A 20% concentration of glycerin acts as an extreme humectant, pulling moisture from the atmosphere directly into the skin’s upper layers.
